comment: Dr. Spencer made econ very interesting for someone who is not a business major. I throughly enjoyed the crime twist she put on econ 101, and would recommend her to anyone thinking of taking econ.

I highly recommend Dr. Spencer. The class is very well-organized and structured, with reading worksheets and homework assignments each week. It can be easy to lose points on tests (there is rarely partial credit), but the tests were straightforward, so as long as you understand the concepts, you should be fine. She is the best!
Econ 101 was hard for me but she was very nice. Would not not recommend her just would not recommend Econ.

.she played such heavy favorites. Certain kids in the class could do whatever they wanted and if others did the same she punished them. She did not like me and my god was the feeling mutual. I was .1 percent away from an A and she refused to round my grade up. Unless you are planning on kissing up to her, do not take her.

she was a great professor and soooo helpful 
definitely reccomend office hours where she can help you one on one

Dr. Spencer makes class engaging and she has a sense of humor. The way she grades homeworks and reading worksheets make it so you basically get an A on all of them which is 20% of your grade. Over half of the exam questions were straight from the homework. She didn't make this class content complicated for no reason, but explains things very simply
Personally, I don't appreciate her attitude. She docks full points with no partial credit, but she is accessible for help. I don't recommend taking her, I couldn't wait the class to be over.

shes a great professor and shes easy to connect with. attending her office hours are a MUST. she makes hard concepts easy to understand but she is a difficult grader on the midterms. lots of opportunities to get good grades and shes really nice!
Very good professor for this class, highly recommended

Class consists of weekly reading worksheet and homework assignment. Classes are lecture style but she throws in fun games and activities that are helpful in learning the content. Majority of your grade is from the two midterms. Easily accessible through office hours. Great prof for first semester of college.

Dr. Spencer was truly one of the best professors I have ever had. Office hours were extremely helpful and easy to schedule. Her lectures were well prepared for and to the point. Test questions come from homework assignments, which she uploads answers to, so pretty predictable which is very helpful. I have learned a lot from this course!

I love Dr. Spencer. Truly one of the best professors I have had. Her lectures are engaging, and homework is incredibly helpful for understanding the material. She's very receptive to the needs of students and helpful during office hours. Exams are fair and not difficult if you study.

I love Dr. Spencer she tries to make learning fun and adds games to her lectures Homework is easy, always worksheet due Monday (participation) 10 problems due Wednesday (only 1 is graded for accuracy) --> Exams are insanely easy if you take notes and do your homework she will often recycle problems -- the whole structure of the class feels like HS

I 100% reccomend!I didn't take AP econ in high school so I was really worried that it would be a hard class. A fair amount of reading but If you put in the effort you're definitely going to do well. Each week we read one chapter/ textbook &complete a 10q problem set.2 midterms and a final. She wants her students to do well! not math heavy! def take
Fast email replier and really nice about explaining things more than one time when students don't understand it.

Dr. Spencer is one of my favorite professors. She is very accessible outside of the classroom and her lectures are very interesting. The readings she gives can be boring, but overall are short and simple. She is a very tough grader, but if you go to her office hours before submitting your assignments, you should end this class with a solid grade.

Dr. Spencer is kind of a like a highschool teacher, which can be good or bad. She wants you to do well, and tries to make things easy for you. She also tries to bring in current event topics which can make a boring class, not as boring, as well as some in-class games. Of all the econ 101 teachers, she is the one you want to take

Dr. Spencer is very organized and puts effort into her lectures. She is not an easy grader and the course is very challenging for students with no previous background in Econ. There are 12 weekly problem sets (very time-consuming), 3 midterms, 2 policy analyses (2 pages), and 1 final exam. Everything is in the textbook and sometimes she is unfair.

Lectures are boring and repetitive. There are three midterms in which she give 0 partial credit. She makes herself available outside of class, but has a hard time explaining concepts she is supposed to be an expert in. Not the move if your testing out Econ or you want to pursue it. Any other prof is better, even craft cause you'll learn something.

Dr. Spencer is very helpful & caring whenever you reach out for help. She tries to make her lectures entertaining & relatable. If you read the textbook, you will pass the course no problem, but you will have to do a bit more studying if you choose not to. Fairly easy grader: 3 midterms, 2 easy policy analyses & short weekly homeworks.

You should definitely take her for Econ101, she makes the best of a pretty boring course because it's just an intro class and is good at explaining concepts. For hw, there are weekly problem sets mostly graded for completion that take 1-2 hours . There's also only 3 exams that are pretty straightforward and the lowest can be replaced by the final.

Professor Spencer is great at explaining basic economic concepts to make them easier to understand for students. She wants students to succeed and will do fun activities to help students better understand concepts. The midterms can be a little difficult but it is all content covered in class that you just have to study well.
